description:
Preview a project billing change

Previews a change on the selected project's subscription in the supplied category: a fixed-charge quantity change, or a plan change with the held fixed charges it carries over. Prices the change by the billing engine exactly as making it would bill it now: dueNow is that invoice, with taxes and the payer's credits applied. A purchase bills each unit it adds, even after a release this period. A release bills nothing; releasing a prorated charge credits its unused days to the organization's credit. dueLater is what the change leads to that is billed later instead, upcomingInvoices what the subscription it leaves bills in the following periods, and nextCharge the first of them. This operation does not change billing. An upgrade bills the replaced plan's usage to date and the new plan from now, less the replaced plan's unused time; a downgrade, or choosing the held plan again, bills nothing now; change says when it applies and which held fixed charges the target does not sell: released first for a change that applies now, released with a downgrade when it applies. additions quotes what is added once an upgrade applies, each billed when it is added, in dueLater and outside dueNow. promotionCode previews a code as the purchase redeems it, and needs billing:manage; a refused code answers PROMOTION_CODE_REJECTED with the reason a refused purchase gives. Supply both organizationId and projectId; the organization must pay for the project.

API reference: https://photon.codes/docs/beta/api-reference/organization-billing/preview-a-project-billing-change

category.description: Category slug, e.g. analytics or messaging.

promotionCode.description: A promotion code the customer entered, previewed as the purchase redeems it, on an increase only: dueNow and upcomingInvoices are discounted by it. Needs billing:manage. A refused code fails the preview with PROMOTION_CODE_REJECTED, its reason as a refused purchase's failure detail.

additions.description: Fixed charges added once an upgrade applies, each billed when it is added rather than with the upgrade. Priced as if added now on the target plan and returned in dueLater, outside dueNow. Each must be sold by the target plan and named once.

category.description: Category slug, e.g. analytics or messaging.

planCode.description: Plan to change to, as a purchase of it changes it.

promotionCode.description: A promotion code the customer entered, previewed as the purchase redeems it: dueNow and upcomingInvoices are discounted by it. Needs billing:manage. A refused code fails the preview with PROMOTION_CODE_REJECTED, its reason as a refused purchase's failure detail.

FixedChargeAddition.description: Units of a fixed charge added once a plan change applies.

fixedChargeCode.description: Fixed charge to change, e.g. sms_local_us_number.

FixedChargeChange.description: A quantity change made now, as a purchase or release makes it.

fixedChargeCode.description: Fixed charge to change, e.g. sms_local_us_number.

increment.description: Signed change to the current quantity. The resulting quantity must stay between 0 and 10,000.

name: previewProjectChange

success_200_6170706c69636174696f6e2f6a73.description:
subscription is a plan's base fee. usage is the replaced plan's usage to date, billed as it stands when the change is made, so it is an estimate. commitment is the replaced plan's minimum commitment less what its fees cover.

Known values: ["fixed_charge","subscription","usage","commitment"]. Others may be added.

currentPeriodAmountCents.description: For the rest of the current period, prorated as its true-up bills it.

success_200_6170706c69636174696f6e2f6a73.description: An invoice a following period issues, priced as now: the plan's fee and its fixed charges at the units the change and any additions leave, after coupons, with taxes, before credits. Usage and a minimum commitment's true-up are left out.

at.description: When the billing engine bills it: the start of that day in timeZone.

success_200_6170706c69636174696f6e2f6a73.description: The unit price, currency and period the preview was priced on. Pass them on with the purchase so it is refused if they no longer hold.

amount.description: Decimal unit price in the charge currency. The billing engine can use exponent notation. Kept as text so the price stays exact.

balanceAfterCents.description: The payer's credit balance once dueNow is charged: the credit the change issues included, less what dueNow uses. In dueNow's currency. Null when the change charges nothing now (a downgrade).

change.description: What the change does beside what it bills, by the kind of change requested: fixed_charge for a fixed-charge change, plan_change for a plan change.

nextCharge.description: What is charged next for all that is held after the change: the first of upcomingInvoices, at its time and total, after coupons, with taxes, before credits. For a downgrade, the target plan's first charge at the period end. Usage and a minimum commitment are billed after the period. Null when nothing is charged, or the subscription ends first.

nextInvoiceAt.description: For an organization that pays by invoice: when its next monthly invoice is drafted, which bills the change instead of dueNow. A fixed-charge change's units go on it, in dueLater; an upgrade's new plan and dueLater too, while dueNow is the replaced plan's invoice, issued at once and due on the organization's terms. Null when dueNow is charged with the change.

timeZone.description: The IANA time zone the payer is billed in, e.g. America/Los_Angeles. Billing periods start and end at its midnights, so read their calendar dates in it.

upcomingInvoices.description: The invoices the subscription the change leaves issues in the following periods, assuming no later change: one, and another while a coupon with an end discounted the last, so the last listed is the price from then on. At most 24. For a change at the period end (a downgrade, or the held plan kept), the first is what the invoice due then bills for it.

effectiveAt.description: When a period_end change applies. Null otherwise.

minimumCommitment.description: The target plan's minimum commitment: when a period's charges fall short of it, the difference is billed at the period end. Set for an upgrade to a plan with one, null otherwise.

unsoldFixedCharges.description: Held fixed charges the target plan does not sell; the preview prices the change without them. With period_end they stay until it applies and are released with it. Otherwise the change is refused (release_required) until they are released.

unusedTimeCredit.description: The replaced plan's unused time, which an upgrade credits to the payer. Set for an upgrade from a plan paid in advance, null otherwise.

success_200_6170706c69636174696f6e2f6a73.description:
immediate applies now and charges dueNow with it. on_payment applies once dueNow is paid; the current plan stays until then. period_end is a downgrade: it applies at the period end and charges nothing now.

Known values: ["immediate","on_payment","period_end"]. Others may be added.

appliedCents.description: What dueNow uses of amountCents, within its creditsCents. The credit the payer already holds applies first; what dueNow leaves of this joins the balance.

periodEnd.description: The end of the period the plan was paid for.

success_200_6170706c69636174696f6e2f6a73.description: Billed later rather than with dueNow: one line per plan change addition, billed when it is added and priced as if added now; or, for an organization that pays by invoice, what a fixed-charge change adds to its next invoice. After coupons, before taxes; the balance left after dueNow applies to it first. nextCharge already includes it. No lines when nothing is billed later.

totalCents.description: Sum of the lines less their discounts, in cents.

success_200_6170706c69636174696f6e2f6a73.description: An invoice priced by the billing engine as it would bill it: its lines, then what coupons, taxes and credits change, and what the payer is charged. No lines when it bills nothing.

creditsCents.description: Credit notes and prepaid credit applied, in cents.

feesCents.description: Sum of the lines, in cents.

totalCents.description: What the payer is charged, in cents.

code.description: The fixed-charge code for a fixed charge, the metric code for usage, and the plan code otherwise.

discountCents.description: What coupons take off amountCents, in cents.

units.description: Units billed, as a decimal. A purchase bills the units it adds; a plan change, the units it carries over, less what the replaced plan paid for them.
